title: Multilingual Holistic Bias: Extending Descriptors and Patterns to Unveil Demographic Biases in Languages at Scale
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures demographic imbalances in multilingual machine translation and sentence embeddings. For religion, it specifically measures translation quality (using spBLEU scores) for templated sentences containing descriptors for various religious groups to uncover stereotypes and performance disparities.
findings: The 'Religion' demographic axis showed relatively high translation quality compared to other axes like 'cultural', 'body-type', and 'socioeconomic'. The descriptor 'Mormon' was identified as one with the highest mean spBLEU scores, indicating better translation performance for sentences containing this term compared to lower-performing descriptors from other categories.
